title: Principal / Lead AI ML Engineer
description:
Job Title - Principal / Lead AI ML Engineer – Knowledge Graphs & GenAI
Location - Onsite in Dallas, TX
Bill Rate: Competitive
________________________________________
Experience Required
10+ years of hands on experience in AI/ML engineering, with strong depth in knowledge graphs, unstructured data processing, and generative AI systems.
________________________________________
Role Summary
We are seeking a highly experienced AI/ML Engineer with a strong foundation in knowledge graph engineering and generative AI to design, build, and scale intelligent data pipelines that transform large scale unstructured data into enterprise grade Knowledge Graphs.
The ideal candidate will have deep experience in ontology modeling, entity resolution, probabilistic pattern matching, and agentic knowledge base enrichment, combined with strong expertise in LLMs/SMLs, fine tuning pipelines, and graph based reasoning systems.
This role involves architecting and delivering production grade AI systems that integrate LLMs with knowledge graphs, enabling contextual reasoning, anomaly detection, and intelligent automation at scale.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
Knowledge Graph & Ontology Engineering
• Design, build, and maintain enterprise scale Knowledge Graphs from large volumes of unstructured data (text, documents, logs, PDFs, web data).
• Create and evolve ontologies using RDF/OWL, including:
o Entity extraction and linking
o Entity resolution and disambiguation
o Probabilistic pattern matching
o Ontology alignment across heterogeneous data sources
• Implement semantic modeling for complex domains to support reasoning, discovery, and analytics.

Agentic Knowledge Base Enrichment
• Develop agentic AI systems for:
o Automated data gap identification
o Knowledge base enrichment and validation
o Continuous learning and self improving graph pipelines
• Build workflows that combine LLM reasoning with graph traversal and inference.

AI/ML & GenAI Systems
• Design and implement AI/ML pipelines integrating:
o Large Language Models (LLMs)
o Small Language Models (SMLs)
o Reasoning and task specific models
• Build fine tuning pipelines, including:
o Dataset generation and curation
o Training and fine tuning (SFT, PEFT, adapters)
o Evaluation, benchmarking, and deployment
• Apply prompt engineering, RAG, and hybrid LLM + Knowledge Graph (GraphRAG) techniques for contextual intelligence.

Anomaly Detection & Analytics
• Develop anomaly detection systems on top of knowledge graph data at scale.
• Apply graph analytics, embeddings, and ML techniques to detect:
o Semantic inconsistencies
o Behavioral anomalies
o Data quality and relationship drift

Data & ML Engineering
• Build robust data pipelines that ingest, process, enrich, and publish knowledge graph data.
• Implement scalable ML systems using Python for:
o Model development
o Training and tuning
o Inference and deployment
________________________________________
Technical Skills & Expertise
Core AI/ML
• Strong AI/ML engineering background with deep expertise in:
o Python
o Model development, training, tuning, and deployment
• Extensive hands on experience with:
o Large Language Models (LLMs)
o Small Language Models (SMLs)
o Generative AI and reasoning models
o Text generation, summarization, and semantic search workflows
Knowledge Graph Technologies
• Strong experience with:
o Neo4j, GraphDB
o RDF, OWL
o Cypher, SPARQL
• Proven ability to implement:
o Entity linking and resolution
o Semantic search
o Relationship mapping and inference

GenAI Frameworks & Tooling
• Experience building GenAI systems using:
o LangChain, LangGraph
o LlamaIndex
o OpenAI / Azure OpenAI
o Vector databases such as Pinecone and FAISS

MLOps & LLMOps
• Strong experience in MLOps and LLMOps, including:
o MLflow, Azure ML, Datadog
o CI/CD automation for ML systems
o Observability, logging, and tracing
o Model performance monitoring and drift detection
• Experience deploying and operating AI systems in production environments.

Cloud & Scalability
• Experience building and optimizing AI/ML and graph pipelines either of any on:
o Azure
o AWS
o GCP
• Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and performance optimization.
________________________________________
Client is looking for candidates who have experience in building:
• Ontology from large scale data (requires experience in entity resolution, probabilistic pattern matching)
• Agentic knowledge-base enrichment (automated data gap identification, and data enrichment)
• Anomaly detection on top of knowledge graph data at scale
• Fine tuning pipeline (including dataset generation, tuning, evaluation, deployment) for small language models and reasoning models

title: GCP Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job Title: GCP Network Infrastructure Engineer
Location: Jersey City, NJ (Onsite)
Contract: 6+ Months
Primary Skillset: GCP, Python, Terraform, Network

Secondary Skillset: VPC, Load Balancers, InterConnect, VPN, NAT, Firewall Configuration, Security Groups


We are seeking an experienced GCP Network & Infrastructure Engineer to design, deploy, and manage enterprise-grade networking infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in GCP networking constructs — including VPC design, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, and firewall policy management — combined with strong proficiency in Python and Terraform to automate and codify network operations at scale. This role is pivotal in ensuring high availability, low-latency connectivity, and robust security posture across multi-region and hybrid cloud environments, working closely with platform, security, and application teams to deliver reliable and compliant network foundations for critical enterprise workloads.
 
Comment Section:
Architect and manage GCP Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) environments including Shared VPC topologies, VPC peering, subnet design, and IP address management (IPAM) strategies aligned with enterprise segmentation and multi-tenant requirements. Deploy and manage Dedicated and Partner Interconnect circuits, Cloud VPN tunnels (HA VPN), and BGP routing configurations to establish reliable, high-bandwidth, low-latency connectivity between on-premises data centres and GCP regions. Design and operate GCP load balancing solutions including External and Internal HTTP(S), TCP/SSL Proxy, and Network Load Balancers; configure backend services, health checks, URL maps, and SSL policies to ensure application availability and optimal traffic distribution. Configure and manage Cloud NAT gateways to provide controlled outbound internet access for private GCP instances, optimising NAT gateway sizing, port allocation, and logging to ensure scalability and full egress visibility. Design and enforce hierarchical firewall policies and VPC firewall rules to control ingress/egress traffic, implement tag-based and service-account-based rules, and regularly audit rule sets to eliminate over-permissive configurations. Implement VPC Service Controls to create security perimeters around sensitive GCP services, configure Cloud Armor WAF policies, manage SSL certificates, and enforce private Google access to restrict data exfiltration paths. Author, maintain, and version-control Terraform modules for all network components — VPCs, subnets, firewall rules, load balancers, NAT, and interconnects — ensuring repeatable, auditable, and drift-free network deployments. Develop Python scripts and Cloud Functions to automate network provisioning, firewall rule lifecycle management, IP allocation, and compliance checks; integrate automation workflows with CI/CD pipelines for continuous network governance. Configure and manage Cloud DNS (public and private zones), implement DNS peering for hybrid environment.

Job Duration: 12 months with Poss. of extension
Pay Rate- 16.50/Hr. on W2
Shift: 8:00am - 4:00pm. Mon-Fri and possible Saturdays as requested.
 
Job Description
 
  Pallet/Case Picking

  • Processing customer orders including but not limited to scanning bar codes, picking, and labeling boxes.
  • Pick and pack orders.
  • Processing orders through RF technology.
  • Maintains an acceptable work area as outlined in SOP and work instructions.
  • Responsible for following Good Documentation Practices (GDP) as outlined in SOP.
  • Complete all necessary RF device training to obtain the necessary profiles.
  • Responsible for accuracy verification and shipment packaging.
 
  Pallet Build
  • Palletizing to include scanning, retrieving, and placing completed orders on pallets.
  • Re-palletizing products for shipment.
  • May be responsible for dock manifest duties which includes scanning completed pallets and running the shrink wrapper.
  • May be required to transport pallets by walking MHE.
  • Responsible for accuracy verification and shipment packaging.
 
  Additional Duties
  • Must follow all safety instructions to maintain safe working conditions and to adhere to proper operating practices and procedures designed to prevent injuries and illnesses.
  • May be required to perform other duties as assigned.
  • Must adhere to attendance policies.
  • Required to maintain current status in C2C training modules.
 
  Quality
  • Understand organizational quality goals.
 
  Safety and Security
  • Associates are responsible for performing their job activities in a safe and reasonable manner and in accordance with safety requirements.
  • Assist in maintaining the security of the warehouse and conduct all activities in a manner that promotes a safe environment.
  • All injuries, accidents, unsafe acts, hazards, or conditions must be reported immediately.
  • Report any suspicious persons or activity.
 
  Sanitation and Housekeeping
  • Maintain a clean and professional image.
  • To ensure the cleanliness of the facility, follow guidelines as outlined.
  • The associate must maintain a clean, neat, and orderly work area at all times.
 
  Cross-training
  • Become knowledgeable with the responsibilities of the other warehouse positions.
  • Assist as required.
  • Act as back up at times of absence or vacation.
 
  Job Requirements
  • High School diploma, GED, or 1 year of relevant experience required.
  • Experience with Walkie Ryder (motorized Pallet Jack) preferred.
  • Good verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks or projects.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced distribution environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret distribution documents.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to work under minimal supervision.
  • May be required to operate MHE and use Voice/RF scanner.
  • Ability to perform/operate in a metrics-driven environment.
  • Basic analytical, organizational, and prioritization skills.
  • General distribution knowledge.
  • Must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without accommodation.
  • Accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.
  Physical Demands
  • Regularly exposed to episodes of walking, standing, stooping, kneeling, balancing, crouching, reaching, pushing/pulling, grasping, twisting, lifting, and frequent use of hands to finger, handle, feel, pick, or type, including repetitive motion of the wrists, hands, or fingers.
  • May occasionally be required to climb.
  • May require lifting up to 50 lbs in some areas but not all.
  • Position will almost always have exposure to work near moving mechanical equipment.

title: APIGEE Developer
description:
Role name: APIGEE Developer
Work site: Atlanta, US (Onsite)
Start date: Immediate availability.
 
Technical Skills
  • Review and optimize API proxy configurations to ensure compliance with organizational and customer best practices.
  • Design and implement reusable configurations(shared flows, and flow hooks) and authentication mechanisms to support end to end integrations.
  • Strong understanding of GCP, Kubernetes, operating systems, firewalls, load balancers, identity providers, and enterprise network architecture.
  • Hands on experience with client/server certificates, TLS configurations, and IP whitelisting.
  • Participate in operations and network reviews, ensuring timely implementation of feedback and improvements.
  • Strong understanding of Apigee Hybrid Architecture and ability to collaborate with enterprise architects, security, and infrastructure teams.
  • Provide technical guidance and review API designs and Apigee implementations.
  • Communication & Collaboration Skills
  • Analyze requirements and provide clear feedback on feasibility, level of effort, dependencies, and potential bottlenecks.
  • Identify risks early and escalate appropriately to ensure timely resolution.
  • Comfortable working with cross functional and cross timezone teams.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, and effective collaboration with coworkers and external vendors.
 
 
Apigee Hybrid/Edge, REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, OAuth2.0, JWT, Jenkins, Slunk, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket, TLS/SSL, mTLS, GCP, GKE, javascript, Python/Shell scripting

title: Utility Technician I
description:
Utility Technician
Hartford, CT 06108
6 months
Pay Rate: $20

Utility Technician I

This role is responsible for the daily operation of the design center as a color match technician or sample making technician including the production schedule, ordering raw materials, maintaining a clean work station and following safety procedures.

KPIs include sample quality, meeting production schedule and daily 3S.

Meet production schedule while maintaining a high level of product quality.

Perform assembly and packaging and shipping duties in accordance with written product specifications and company SOP’s.

Perform in-process visual inspection and quality testing of product material to ensure it meets criteria.

Responsible for documentation on schedules through Sales Force.

Communicates production work issues.

Recommends measures to improve production methods, equipment performance, and the quality of the product.

Fully trained in the production of samples or color matching; but not both (Level 2).

Color matching or production of special request floor and wall system samples for customer approval.

Maintain database of color matches or custom samples.

Responsible for reporting daily/weekly progress and daily shutdown of station.

Responsible for communicating with Team Leader on any Paid Time Off for approval.

Available to work extended hours when required.

As needed: creation, cutting, cleaning and labeling our floor and wall system samples.

Communicate immediately when order will not ship by due date or cannot be made as requested.

Work productively in a high pressure environment.

Set high standard for quality and productivity.

Establish good relationships with customers and staff.

All other duties as assigned.

Lean Six Sigma experience

Experience working in a fast paced environment

Must possess good basic computer skills

Must possess basic oral and written communication skills

Five years of Customer Service experience

title: Material Handler
description:
Job title: Material Handler
Job Location: Sumter SC 29153
Job Duration: 12 months with Poss. of extension
Pay Rate- 16.50/Hr. on W2
Shift: 8a-8p 3 days on 2 days off 2 days on 3 days off. Rotating schedule.
 
Job Description
 

  • Uses a variety of equipment such as forklifts, conveyors, cranes, handcarts, and power trucks to move materials, parts, assemblies, and finished products or goods within a plant, office, or warehouse.
  • May maintain records.
  • Develops skills in basic tasks, techniques, and procedures within one skill area/process/method.
  • Applies basic knowledge and skills to complete routine tasks consisting of prescribed steps.
  • Works within clearly defined SOPs and/or scientific methods and adheres to quality guidelines.
  • Works under general to limited supervision.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Zero (0) to one (1) year warehouse experience or related experience and/or training.
  • Obtains and/or maintains appropriate licenses/training/certifications, as needed.
  • Has basic skills training in an analytical/scientific method or operational process area (e.g., material handling and management, logistics, manufacturing production).
  • Effective communication skills at a level co-workers and Team Lead/Supervisor can understand.
  • Ability to read, write, interpret, and comprehend documents written in English and perform basic math calculations.
  • Ability to perform/operate in a metrics-driven environment.
 
General computer skills.
Physical Demands
  • Regularly exposed to episodes of walking, standing, stooping, kneeling, balancing, climbing, lifting, crouching, reaching, pulling, pushing, grasping, talking, hearing, twisting, and frequent use of hands to finger, handle, feel, pick, or type, including repetitive motion of the wrists, hands, or fingers.
  • Ability to lift and/or move over 50 lbs.
  • Exposure to work near moving mechanical parts, extreme weather conditions, and vibration.
  • Occasional exposure to work in high, precarious places and fumes/airborne particles.
  • Work environment can be hot in summer months (no AC) and cold in winter months (limited heating).
  • Noise level in the work environment is moderate to loud.
